question:
A series $LCR$ circuit is connected to a constant rms voltage source. It is observed that the rms current has the **same value** at two frequencies $f_1=40\,\text{Hz}$ and $f_2=90\,\text{Hz}$. At these two frequencies, the phase angles of current with respect to voltage are measured to be $\phi_1=-60^\circ$ (current leads) at $40\,\text{Hz}$ and $\phi_2=+60^\circ$ (current lags) at $90\,\text{Hz}$.

Assuming $R,\,L,\,C$ are constant and the circuit contains only these elements in series, the resonance frequency $f_0$ of the circuit is closest to:
